notes: All five read as built masonry or layer cake, not fractured rock: cliff_04 and the right tower of cliff_02 are stacks of equal-height horizontal slabs, cliff_05 is a grid of rectangular blocks and cliff_03 reads as a ruined wall with a doorway gap. Moss on cliff_01/03/05 is thick flat pads (lids) in a cooler, more saturated green (hue ~95) than the boulder moss (~80), so the set does not match the boulder kit.
